openenv-wq4mt is in state DELETE_REQUESTED. It was created 2026-05-30 at 07:22 UTC, and its labels record guid wq4mt, envtype gcp-base, owner dmoreau, and conan cleanup-pending.

Yes -- that state explains the deployment failure directly. A GCP project in DELETE_REQUESTED is scheduled for deletion and rejects new resource creation, so nothing can be deployed into it regardless of permissions or quota. The conan label being cleanup-pending says the same thing from the RHDP side: the sandbox reaper has already marked this environment for teardown.

So this is not something to fix inside the project. Whoever needs to deploy wants a fresh sandbox -- and if the deletion was not expected, that is the thing to query, since a project in this state cannot be returned to ACTIVE by the requester.
